Everybody stood up and warmly applauded to honour his coming.

John told me that the President would honour me by meeting me in the White House.

I'll be greatly honoured by your gracious presence.
如蒙光临，不胜荣幸。

I only honoured my promise to your father.

[hɔp]
vi.
(蛙、鸟等)齐足跳跃；齐足跳行；跳跃：
Gazelles often hop when running.

(人)单足跳跃；单足跳行；跛行：
The children were hopping to play on the ground.

Ok,ok,don't hop along, mind your wounded foot!
好了，好了，别跳了，留神你的伤脚吧!
[口语]跳行似的移动(或前进)：
He hopped to and fro between London and Paris for the business.
为了这笔生意他曾不停地往返于伦敦和巴黎。
[口语]走开，离开：
I hope you hop out of my house at once.
我劝你马上离开我的家。
[口语]跳，弹跳；快速行走：
He hopped back up the stairs and took his pistol.

[口语]跳舞
坐飞机；作短途飞行：
They've hopped to Hawaii for holidays.

to hop a puddle
